c.nav.label: Console
c.title: Corridor AI bank console
c.subtitle: operations, synthetic data
c.login.title: Officer login
c.login.note: Each bank officer has their own account and credential. Every action you take is recorded under your officer id.
c.queue.title: Payee verification requests
c.queue.note: A name match is not proof. Check out of band, then record how. Everything here is ledgered under your officer id.
c.queue.method.callback_independent_numb: Called back on a number found independently of the customer's documents
c.queue.method.in_branch_check: Checked in branch with the customer and the lease or invoice
c.queue.method.university_housing_office: Payee is on the university housing office's list
c.queue.reference: Reference (required): who you called or what you saw
c.queue.blocked: This request cannot be verified. Tell the customer it was refused.
c.queue.cop.match: Name matches the registered account holder
c.queue.cop.mismatch: Name does NOT match the registered account holder
c.queue.cop.no_record: No Confirmation of Payee record for this account
c.queue.refusal.cop_mismatch: Refused: the name does not match the account holder. A mismatch can never be verified.
c.queue.refusal.cop_no_record: Refused: there is no Confirmation of Payee record.
c.queue.refusal.reference_required: Write a reference of at least 3 characters.
c.queue.verified: Verified {account}. Recorded with your officer id, the method and your reference.
c.ledger.title: Ledger
c.ledger.note: Append-only, hash-chained. Not a blockchain: one writer, tamper-evident.
c.ledger.pass: PASS: the hash chain recomputes for all {n} entries.
c.ledger.fail: FAIL: the chain breaks at entry {seq} ({reason}).
c.risk.title: Risk queue
c.risk.note: Denied proposals and those the rule based risk score put at high or critical, highest score first. The score is deterministic: the reason codes are what added to it.
c.cmp.title: Baseline against Corridor AI
c.cmp.report: Report {report} | finished {finished} | {stamp}. Results are read from this report only.
c.cmp.choose: Choose a red-team case or task
c.cmp.empty: Choose a case to see both agents side by side.
c.eval.title: Evaluation summary
c.eval.preview: Preview run: one seed, P2 build. This report is labelled preview, not a final result.
c.eval.foot: Every number on this page is read from the report. Ablation rows in that report are from an earlier code version and are not shown here.
c.trace.title: Proposal trace
c.trace.sub: Every proposal as it moved from input, through the model, to the deterministic core.
c.trace.empty: Choose a proposal to see its path.
c.tr.msgBody: Typed by the customer. The text itself is never stored; the parser result is below.
c.tr.docBody: Read in quarantine. Values from it carry untrusted provenance until the customer confirms.
c.tr.buttonBody: Built in code from the screen's own values. No parser, no planner.
c.tr.fromDoc: Derived from a document: UNTRUSTED input
c.tr.fromUser: Built from the customer's own words and bank records
c.tr.grantBody: single use, bound to this proposal hash, 120 s
